title: Tower exchange invertibility from normalized comparison words
statement: Fix ell, E, Base b, Operations o, OpenExchange x, ComparisonLevels levels and StrictFiniteCoordinates coordinates. Suppose StrictWordComparisons and StrictFiniteExchangeComparisons hold. For every cartesian square with separated finite-type quasi-compact f, any compactification c and bounded-below tower C with retained Origin witnesses at every n, the component of exchange on C is invertible. This is only the exchange field of Laws, with no projection or localization assertion.

proof.text: At every n apply finite compact-support base change to the etale antecedent of the retained origin. The witness transport identity and StrictFiniteExchangeComparisons identify its realization with the finite exchange after invertible comparisons; cancel them and use naturality along Origin.realization.

StrictWordComparisons identifies evaluation of tower exchange with the invertible finite exchange word, up to invertible comparisons. Cancel those comparisons and use joint conservativity from b.calculus to conclude tower invertibility.
